data.name: Angelic: Dark Symphony
data.detailed_description:
A CINEMATIC TACTICAL RPG.

Built for players who want deep storytelling, cinematic spectacle, and strategic combat that rewards wits over reflexes.

Lead a cast of neo-human “angels” through tactical missions, reactive encounters, and impossible choices in a dark sci-fi universe where every battle is part of a larger story.

Angelic: Dark Symphony blends cinematic storytelling with hero-driven turn-based combat. Command distinct characters, combine signature abilities, exploit the environment, and survive brutal encounters where positioning, timing, and team synergy matter more than reflexes.

EARTH IS DYING. HUMANS ARE OBSOLETE. ANGELS ARE COMING BACK.

Humanity ruined its world, then tried to save itself by creating immortal synthetic beings built to surpass the limits of flesh.

They called them angels.

Then they tried to destroy them.

Two centuries after the angels vanished, something dark returns with them. Angelic invites you into a universe where carbon, silicon, and dread collide beneath the will of an incomprehensible goddess.

EVERY HERO IS UNIQUE. EVERYTHING IS CUSTOMIZABLE.

Master distinct heroes, signature abilities, tactical combos, and lethal environmental plays.

Every hero in Angelic brings a different combat identity, story texture, and tactical purpose.

Your heroes are not interchangeable units. They are characters with motives, loyalties, fears, ambitions, and memories.

The way you lead them matters.

Hero-Driven Tactics: Every hero opens up new stories, paths, and synergies.

Signature Abilities: Unleash dramatic powers, tactical combos, and cinematic finishing moments unique to each hero.

Deep Customization: Shape heroes through progression, skill choices, evolving combat roles and, of course, cosmetic customizations.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT: THE DREADHEAVEN COLONY.

The first campaign brings you to a neo-human colony once known as The Heaven. You are sent to investigate why the colony went dark.

It will be a long day, and an even longer night. For everyone.

The Dreadheaven campaign throws your heroes into a nightmare of infestation, shattered survivors, impossible odds, and cosmic horror. What begins as an intriguing mission becomes a descent into a place where love, dread, hope, and despair collapse into one another.

Survive the colony. Face what came through the dark. And learn why the symphony has only begun.

CHOICES THAT HAUNT.

Your decisions echo through key moments.

You cannot command the whole symphony, but the notes you strike will be felt.

Angelic is built around heroes who are more than weapons. They carry loyalties, trauma, ambitions, doubts, and relationships into battle.

In the dark universe of Angelic, death and failure are never far away. What matters is not only whether you survive, but how you survive. And, perhaps more importantly, how you die.

A FREE MULTIPLAYER ADD-ON: THE CHAOS THEATRE.

Test your skills against AI and other players in the Chaos Theatre, a free multiplayer add-on where angels enter combat simulations to hone their skills.

Experiment with heroes, team compositions, tactical counters, and combat scenarios across multiple modes.

Co-op, PvP, FFA, and multiple battlefield variations turn the Chaos Theatre into a playground for players who want to master Angelic’s combat beyond the story campaign.

data.short_description: Experience a cinematic sci-fi RPG through the shifting perspectives of a complex cast. Each hero reshapes turn-based combat, from brutal melee and gunplay to aerial battles and gravity-bending powers. Uncover a dark cosmic story where death may be the kinder ending.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Spanish - Latin America, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 8 GB / Radeon RX Vega 56 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Additional Notes: Final system requirements and performance targets will be announced following optimization and compatibility testing.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2080 8 GB / RX 6700 XT 12 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
